pipeline.name: AI-Driven End-to-End Quality Automation Framework
pipeline.description: Autonomous QE lifecycle: requirements → scenarios → test cases → automation → execution → reporting → defects → retest
pipeline._agentSequenceNote: The seven implemented skills in .kiro/skills/. There is NO 'regression' skill in v4. Business-domain and full-regression RUNS are handled by the execution skill's domain/full modes (grep by @domain / no filter) — not a separate agent.

jira._note: projectKey is NOT stored here — it is DERIVED from the story key at runtime (e.g. TCOE-1356 → TCOE). cloudId resolved from idpchange.atlassian.net via getAccessibleAtlassianResources.

apps._doc: Per-application registry. Each app = one long-lived git repo + one ISOLATED regression suite (Option B). Key = JIRA project prefix (story key before the dash, e.g. TCOE-101 → 'TCOE'). Suites never mix across apps.
apps._resolution: appKey = storyKey.split('-')[0]. If no entry matches → HALT and ask the user to register the app here. Never guess a repo, suite path, or URL.

TCOE._pkbDirNote: Per-app Product Knowledge Base (live-app documentation) owned by the product-knowledge-skill and read by the planner. Already populated for TCOE (screens/, workflows/, business-rules.md, navigation-map.md).

git._note: Long-lived repo for this app. Only needed for the Scripting (automation) phase — Planning and Tester do NOT need it. Fill projectPath (and confirm defaultBranch) before running Run Scripting for TCOE-XXX. Repo must already exist.

execution._hyperExecutePathNote: Relative to the workspace root. Provision the binary at the root; do not commit user-specific absolute paths.
execution.remoteRouting: Option B (cloud overlay): execution injects LT_CDP_URL (built via execution-skill/assets/playwright-cloud-config.ts) into the HyperExecute YAML env; the app's playwright.config.ts reads it into use.connectOptions.wsEndpoint. No lambdatest-setup.ts; specs import from fixtures/ only.
execution.autoHealNote: Grid selector auto-heal DISABLED — it masks selector breakage (false green). Fix selectors in Page Objects with DOM evidence via the Automation skill.

outputs._note: Per-story pipeline artifacts are keyed by STORY-KEY and app-agnostic in path. Generated CODE goes into the app's isolated suite at apps.{APP}.suiteDir — NOT a single shared regression-suite/.

inputs.envConfig: Resolved per app from apps.{APP}.envConfig (e.g. env_config.TCOE.json). Copy env_config.template.json to create a new one.
inputs.regressionSuite: Resolved per app from apps.{APP}.suiteDir. Each app has its own registry/, playwright.config.ts, and core/.
